basic_info.description: Discover the charm of 4035 20th Street, nestled in the heart of one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods Dolores Heights/Eureka Valley. Located on a serene cul-de-sac just off Noe Street, this home offers an unbeatable combination of privacy, tranquility, and partial downtown views. 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms across two levels, elegant arched doorways and windows that enhance the home's architectural beauty, oak hardwood flooring and recessed lighting throughout. Cozy up by the two fireplaces or relax on the private outdoor patio, enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a front deck that connects seamlessly from the living room, offering partial views, skylights fill the top floor with natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance, formal living room and a flexible additional room, perfect as an office or 4th sleeping area, convenient elevator access for easy movement between floors, 2-car garage with 2 additional driveway parking spaces for ultimate convenience. Explore the lively Noe Valley neighborhood, Dolores Park or The Castro, 4035 20th Street offers the perfect balance of city living and quiet sanctuary. Don't miss your chance to experience this extraordinary home!
